# Havells India

> > Leading Indian electrical equipment manufacturer offering modular switches, LED lighting, home automation, and consumer electrical products with Made in India manufacturing facilities.

Havells India Ltd. is a major electrical equipment company with manufacturing facilities across India, offering product lines including Amare and Coral modular switches, LED lighting solutions, and smart home automation systems. The company operates under various regulatory frameworks including CLRA, ESI Act, EPF Act, and GST compliance.

## Key Topics

- Modular Switches
- LED Lighting Solutions
- Electrical Switches
- Smart Home Automation
- Made in India Manufacturing
- Industry 4.0
- CSR Initiatives (STEPS Program)
- Contract Labour Compliance (CLRA)
- Product Catalog
- Coral Modular Range
- Amare Switch Series
- Home Art Light Collection
- Energy-Efficient Lighting
- R&D Facilities

## Switches & Electrical Products

- [Havells Amare Switches: Modern Design, Intelligent Functionality for Your Home](https://havells.com/switches/amare.html): Amare modular switches product line with smart home automation features

- [32 A DP Switch with Indicator](https://havells.com/switches/signia/32-a-dp-switch-with-indicator-acwsdig321.html): Signia 32A double pole switch with indicator specifications and details
